title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Lapse, Reinstatement and Cancellation Schedule
content:
For each coverage level of the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, this schedule fixes when an unpaid protection fee lapses the plan, how long a lapsed plan can be reinstated, and the terms on which the tenant cancels. All periods are calendar days.

## Schedule

| Coverage level | Lapse (days after an unpaid fee's billing date) | Reinstatement window (days after the lapse date) | Proof of own insurance to cancel | Partial month refunded on cancellation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 30 | 60 | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 30 | 60 | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 30 | 60 | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 30 | 60 | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 45 | 60 | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 45 | 60 | Yes | No |

- **Cancellation effective date:** at every level a tenant cancellation takes effect on the covered rental's next billing date.
- **Proof of insurance:** at every level the tenant must name their own insurer and policy number to cancel.
- **Proration:** at no level is a partial month's protection fee refunded on cancellation.

## Points of reading

The lapse period is 30 days on the $2,000, $3,000, $5,000 and $7,500 Plans and 45 days on the $10,000 and $15,000 Plans. The reinstatement window is 60 days at every level.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A fee billed on a hypothetical day 0 and still unpaid would reach the lapse period on day 30 under a $3,000 Plan and on day 45 under a $15,000 Plan.
